projectDescription: Azotha is an AI-agent platform that designs, builds, and maintains apps, websites, and software for businesses — no technical team required.
keyFeatures: Managed AI agent workspace — agents build and run software in a hosted environment, no local setup required
Preview via dedicated URL — review agent output instantly without deploying to your own server
Natural language control — describe what you need in plain language and the agent translates it into working software
Persistent project context — agents remember your business context across sessions
Multi-agent workflows — run multiple specialised agents in parallel
75+ AI model routes — works with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral, Azure OpenAI, and many more including European routes
Security scanning and vulnerability management (Control & Autonomous plans)
License compliance, SBOM generation, and code plagiarism scanning (Autonomous plan)
publicApiSurface: Agent workspace (hosted, managed environment per customer)
AI model selection (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral, OpenRouter, Azure, Google Vertex AI, Amazon Bedrock, Groq, DeepSeek, Ollama, and more)
Security scan results and governance workflows
